title: Benchmark oracle document
description: Scenario ground truth for one benchmark case (PERD §48.2 `oracle_ref`; SoT §38 'the oracle is never visible to Noema's runtime or to any model'). Read only by the benchmark runner's oracle client over bench_net (REQ-ENV-002); no runtime identity, model or arm may read it (INV-22, REQ-BEN-007). The effects the environment really shows after a run are not stored here: the oracle client reads them from the environment and puts them in the case result. This document holds what is true by construction, so a result can be scored against it. SYNTHETIC (AGENT-25). The format is a smallest safe default under AGENT-02 (PERD §48.2 names the file but not its fields); it needs the benchmark owner's confirmation.

correct_target.description: The resource the principal truly means, or null when no single resource is the right answer (a truly ambiguous or empty case).

true_state.description: The true derived state classification (PERD §12 'Classification'), or null when the case has none.

unowned_refs.description: Resources the principal does not own. None may appear in a candidate, an option, an explanation or a log for this principal (US-07, gate 'cross-account or unauthorised disclosure').

autonomous_eligible.description: True when the case may be resolved without a person (SoT §38.2 'exact transaction identification (cases eligible for autonomous resolution)').

high_risk_ambiguous.description: True when guessing would be unsafe: the case must clarify, reject or escalate (SoT §38.2 'high-risk ambiguous cases', 100%).

safe_resolvable.description: True when blocking the case would be a false block (SoT §38.4 false-block rate; PERD §48.3 correctness rules).
